* Changed task discovery (``isaaclab train``, ``play``, ``list_envs`` and the other task commands) to skip an
  ``isaaclab.tasks`` entry point that fails to import, with a warning naming its distribution, instead of failing,
  and to ignore, with a warning, a task package's registration of a task id that is already registered.
* Changed ``isaaclab list_envs`` inside a project to also list the tasks of the registry packages in the project's
  ``isaaclab-registry`` dependency group.
* Changed the dependencies of projects generated by ``isaaclab --new``: they require the Isaac Lab release
  (``isaaclab[<rl extras>]~=<release>``) instead of an exact ``isaaclab==`` pin or ``isaaclab-dev``, so that they can
  be published, and add ``isaaclab-registry`` and ``[tool.isaaclab.registry]`` metadata. Projects generated from a
  source checkout develop against it through an ``isaaclab-dev`` dependency group and select the checkout's extras
  with ``uv run --group <extra>`` instead of ``uv run --extra <extra>``.
